description: The instructor's comments on your graded submission for one Canvas assignment, with the score and grade. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name and assignment as the assignment ID or its name. Example: "What did the teacher say about my Lab 4 submission in Networking 1?"

assignment.description: The assignment ID or the assignment name, for example Lab 4. Ask get_assignments for the list.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.

name: get_submission_feedback
title: Submission feedback
